overview.en: This chapter covers normal physiologic recovery after birth (involution, lochia, breasts, urinary and GI changes, vital signs), routine postpartum assessment and teaching, common discomforts, emotional changes, and breast-feeding/chest-feeding. Know what is normal versus a red flag for hemorrhage or infection.
overview.zh: 本章說明產後正常生理恢復（子宮復舊、惡露、乳房、泌尿與腸胃變化、生命徵象）、產後評估與衛教、常見不適、情緒變化與哺乳。重點在分辨正常與出血或感染的警訊。

points.en: The postpartum period runs from birth to about 6 weeks.
points.zh: 產後期從分娩後至約6週。

points.en: Uterus shrinks from about 2 lb (900 g) to 2 oz (57 g) in 6 weeks; fundus descends about 1 cm/day and is not palpable abdominally by day 10. Breast-/chest-feeding speeds involution through oxytocin.
points.zh: 子宮於6週內由約2磅（900 g）縮至2盎司（57 g）；子宮底每日下降約1公分，第10天腹部已摸不到。哺乳透過催產素加速復舊。

points.en: Boggy (flaccid) fundus = atony, massage until firm; tender fundus suggests infection; a full bladder displaces the uterus upward and prevents contraction, so have client void before assessment.
points.zh: 子宮軟而鬆弛＝子宮收縮不良，需按摩至變硬；子宮壓痛提示感染；膀胱脹滿會將子宮推高並妨礙收縮，評估前先請產婦排尿。

points.en: Afterpains are more common in multiparas, nursing parents, oxytocin use, and overdistended uterus.
points.zh: 後陣痛較常見於經產婦、哺乳者、使用催產素及子宮過度膨脹者。

points.en: Rubra: bright red, days 0-3. Serosa: brownish pink, days 4-10. Alba: white, days 11-14.
points.zh: 紅惡露：鮮紅，第0至3天；漿液惡露：粉褐色，第4至10天；白惡露：白色，第11至14天。

points.en: Normal odor resembles menstrual flow; foul odor suggests infection. Large clots (>1 cm) or saturating a pad in 15 minutes (excessive) need provider notification.
points.zh: 正常氣味似月經；惡臭提示感染。血塊大於1公分或15分鐘浸濕一片護墊（過量）需通知醫師。

points.en: Amount: scant <2.5 cm/hr, light <10 cm, moderate <15 cm, heavy saturated in 1 hr, excessive saturated in 15 min. Weigh pads for accuracy.
points.zh: 量：極少（每小時<2.5 cm）、少（<10 cm）、中（<15 cm）、多（1小時浸濕）、過多（15分鐘浸濕）。可秤護墊重量以求準確。

heading.en: Other physiologic changes and vital signs
heading.zh: 其他生理變化與生命徵象

points.en: Menses return in 1-2 months if not nursing, 3-6 months if nursing; ovulation can precede menses, so lactation is not reliable contraception.
points.zh: 未哺乳者1至2個月月經恢復，哺乳者約3至6個月；可能先排卵再來月經，因此哺乳不是可靠的避孕。

points.en: Colostrum 48-72 hr; milk comes in day 3; engorgement about day 4. Non-nursing: snug bra/binder, ice, avoid nipple stimulation; resolves in 24-36 hr.
points.zh: 初乳持續48至72小時；第3天泌乳；約第4天脹奶。未哺乳者：穿緊身胸罩或束帶、冰敷、避免刺激乳頭；24至36小時緩解。

points.en: Diuresis begins within 12 hr; urinary retention is possible; bowel movement by day 2-3; hemorrhoids common.
points.zh: 12小時內開始利尿；可能尿滯留；第2至3天排便；痔瘡常見。

points.en: Temp may reach 100.4 F (38 C) in first 24 hr from dehydration, higher suggests infection. Pulse may fall to 50 (normal); >100 suggests hemorrhage or infection. Falling BP suggests hypovolemia; rising respirations suggest PE, atony or hemorrhage.
points.zh: 前24小時因脫水體溫可達100.4°F（38°C），更高提示感染。脈搏可降至50次/分（正常）；大於100提示出血或感染。血壓下降提示低血容量；呼吸明顯加快提示肺栓塞、子宮收縮不良或出血。

points.en: Orthostatic hypotension may occur in the first 8 hours: assist when getting up.
points.zh: 產後前8小時可能有姿勢性低血壓：下床需有人協助。

points.en: Assess vital signs, pain, fundus (height, consistency, location after voiding), lochia, breasts, perineum (REEDA-type swelling/discoloration), incisions, bowel, I&O, calf for thrombophlebitis, bonding, emotions.
points.zh: 評估生命徵象、疼痛、子宮底（排尿後測高度、硬度、位置）、惡露、乳房、會陰（腫脹或瘀青）、傷口、腸道、輸出入量、小腿血栓靜脈炎、親子依附與情緒。

points.en: Give Rho(D) immune globulin within 72 hours to Rh-negative clients with Rh-positive newborn; check rubella immunity and vaccinate if nonimmune, avoid conception 1-3 months.
points.zh: Rh陰性且新生兒為Rh陽性者，72小時內給予Rho(D)免疫球蛋白；確認德國麻疹免疫，無免疫者接種疫苗，之後1至3個月避免受孕。

points.en: Teach: no heavy lifting for 3 weeks, daily rest, delay intercourse until lochia stops, follow-up at 4-6 weeks, report chills, fever, increased lochia, or depressed mood.
points.zh: 衛教：3週內避免提重物、每日休息、惡露停止後再行房、4至6週回診、有畏寒、發燒、惡露增多或情緒低落立即通報。

points.en: Perineum/episiotomy: ice first 24 hours then sitz baths; perineal care after voiding; analgesic spray; avoid suppositories/enemas with lacerations.
points.zh: 會陰／會陰切開：前24小時冰敷，之後坐浴；排尿後做會陰護理；使用止痛噴劑；有撕裂傷時避免塞劑與灌腸。

points.en: Constipation: 2000 mL fluid/day, fiber, ambulation, stool softener if prescribed.
points.zh: 便秘：每日2000 mL水分、高纖飲食、走動、依醫囑用軟便劑。

points.en: Postpartum blues: tearfulness, mood swings, anxiety, fatigue, usually self-limited. Depression: guilt, loss of pleasure, less responsive to infant, suicidal thoughts. Psychosis: delusions, hallucinations, confusion, break with reality (emergency).
points.zh: 產後憂鬱情緒：愛哭、情緒起伏、焦慮、疲倦，通常自行緩解。產後憂鬱症：罪惡感、失去興趣、對嬰兒反應少、自殺意念。產後精神病：妄想、幻覺、混亂、脫離現實（急症）。

points.en: All clients should be screened for depression in pregnancy and postpartum.
points.zh: 所有孕產婦於孕期與產後均應篩檢憂鬱。

points.en: Nursing parents need 200-500 extra kcal/day, more fluids, and continued prenatal vitamins; avoid alcohol, unprescribed medications, gas-forming foods and caffeine.
points.zh: 哺乳者每日增加200至500大卡、多喝水、持續服用孕期維生素；避免酒精、未經處方藥物、產氣食物與咖啡因。

points.en: Start feeding early; use LATCH (Latch, Audible swallowing, Type of nipple, Comfort, Hold).
points.zh: 儘早開始哺乳；以LATCH評估（含乳、吞嚥聲、乳頭型態、舒適度、抱姿）。

points.en: Wash breasts with water only (no soap); supportive non-underwire bra day and night; air-dry cracked nipples 10-20 min, ensure areolar latch, rotate positions.
points.zh: 乳房只用清水清潔（不用肥皂）；日夜穿支撐型無鋼圈胸罩；乳頭皸裂時風乾10至20分鐘、確保含住乳暈、輪換姿勢。

points.en: Engorgement: feed frequently, warm before, cold between feeds, massage. Estrogen-containing pills not recommended; progestin-only less likely to reduce milk.
points.zh: 脹奶：頻繁哺乳、餵前熱敷、餵後冷敷、按摩。不建議含雌激素避孕藥；單純黃體素較不影響奶量。

points.en: Newborn stools are light yellow, seedy, watery, frequent.
points.zh: 母乳寶寶糞便為淺黃色、顆粒狀、水樣、次數多。

critical_points.en: Boggy uterus: massage the fundus until firm (first check bladder); never push on an uncontracted uterus (inversion risk).
critical_points.zh: 子宮鬆軟：按摩至變硬（先確認膀胱排空）；切勿用力推壓未收縮的子宮（有內翻風險）。

critical_points.en: Saturating a pad in 15 minutes = excessive bleeding: massage fundus, notify the provider.
critical_points.zh: 15分鐘浸濕一片護墊＝過量出血：按摩子宮底並通知醫師。

critical_points.en: Clots larger than 1 cm are abnormal; notify provider.
critical_points.zh: 大於1公分血塊為異常，需通知醫師。

critical_points.en: Lochia: rubra 0-3 days, serosa 4-10, alba 11-14; foul odor = infection.
critical_points.zh: 惡露：紅色0至3天、漿液4至10天、白色11至14天；惡臭＝感染。

critical_points.en: Temp up to 100.4 F in first 24 hr is expected; push oral fluids.
critical_points.zh: 前24小時體溫至100.4°F屬預期；鼓勵多喝水。

critical_points.en: Pulse >100, falling BP, and restlessness suggest hemorrhage; a pulse of 50 to 60 can be normal postpartum bradycardia.
critical_points.zh: 脈搏大於100、血壓下降、躁動提示出血；產後脈搏50至60可為正常心搏過緩。

critical_points.en: Full bladder pushes the uterus up and to the side and causes atony.
critical_points.zh: 膀胱脹滿會把子宮推向上方與側邊並導致收縮不良。

critical_points.en: Rh-negative mother with Rh-positive newborn: Rho(D) immune globulin within 72 hours.
critical_points.zh: Rh陰性母親、Rh陽性新生兒：72小時內給Rho(D)免疫球蛋白。

critical_points.en: Rubella-nonimmune: vaccinate postpartum, avoid pregnancy for 1-3 months.
critical_points.zh: 德國麻疹無免疫：產後接種，1至3個月內避免懷孕。

critical_points.en: Ice perineum first 24 hours, then sitz baths.
critical_points.zh: 會陰前24小時冰敷，之後坐浴。

critical_points.en: Breast-feeding is not reliable contraception; avoid estrogen pills while nursing.
critical_points.zh: 哺乳不是可靠避孕；哺乳期避免含雌激素避孕藥。

critical_points.en: Do not use soap on nipples; air-dry cracked nipples; do not limit feeding during engorgement.
critical_points.zh: 乳頭不用肥皂；皸裂乳頭風乾；脹奶時不要限制哺乳。

critical_points.en: Calf pain, warmth, redness suggests thrombophlebitis; postpartum depression requires screening and suicide risk assessment.
critical_points.zh: 小腿疼痛、溫熱、紅腫提示血栓靜脈炎；產後憂鬱需篩檢並評估自殺風險。

critical_points.en: After cesarean, delay abdominal exercises for 3-4 weeks; get out of bed by turning on the side and pushing up.
critical_points.zh: 剖腹產後3至4週才做腹部運動；下床時先側身再用手臂撐起。

mnemonics.en: Lochia colors: RSA - Rubra (red), Serosa (pink-brown), Alba (white).
mnemonics.zh: 惡露顏色RSA：紅（Rubra）、漿液粉褐（Serosa）、白（Alba）。

mnemonics.en: BUBBLE-HE postpartum check: Breasts, Uterus, Bladder, Bowels, Lochia, Episiotomy/perineum, Homans/legs, Emotions.
mnemonics.zh: BUBBLE-HE產後檢查：乳房、子宮、膀胱、腸道、惡露、會陰、下肢、情緒。

mnemonics.en: LATCH: Latch, Audible swallowing, Type of nipple, Comfort, Hold.
mnemonics.zh: LATCH：含乳、吞嚥聲、乳頭型態、舒適度、抱姿。

stem.en: On palpation of a client 2 hours postpartum, the uterus is soft and boggy. What is the first action?
stem.zh: 產後2小時觸診發現子宮柔軟鬆弛。第一步處置為何？

rationale.en: Massage stimulates contraction; pushing on an atonic uterus risks inversion.
rationale.zh: 按摩可促進子宮收縮；推壓鬆弛子宮有內翻風險。

stem.en: Which finding in a 1-day postpartum client requires follow-up?
stem.zh: 下列哪項產後第1天的發現需要追蹤處理？

rationale.en: Foul lochia suggests infection; the others are normal.
rationale.zh: 惡臭惡露提示感染；其他皆為正常。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statements by a nursing client show understanding? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哺乳產婦的哪些說法表示了解衛教內容？（複選）

options.en: I will wear a supportive bra.
I will wash my nipples with soap daily.
I will keep drinking extra fluids.
I do not need contraception while nursing.
I will air-dry cracked nipples after feeds.
options.zh: 餵奶後我會讓皸裂的乳頭風乾。

rationale.en: Soap dries the nipples, and ovulation can occur before menses so contraception is still needed.
rationale.zh: 肥皂會使乳頭乾燥；且可能先排卵，仍需避孕。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client 4 hours postpartum has a temperature of 100.2 F (37.8 C), otherwise stable. What is the best action?
stem.zh: 產後4小時體溫100.2°F（37.8°C），其餘穩定。最佳處置為何？

rationale.en: Temperature up to 100.4 F in 24 hours is from dehydration.

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A postpartum client is pale and restless with BP 100/60 (baseline 122/80) and pulse 110. The pad is saturated with clots. What does the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 產後婦女蒼白躁動，血壓100/60（原122/80）、脈搏110，護墊被血塊浸濕。護理師首先做什麼？

options.en: Check the fundus and massage if boggy, then notify the provider
options.zh: 檢查子宮底，鬆軟則按摩，並通知醫師

rationale.en: Signs of hypovolemia from atony need immediate fundal massage and provider notification.
rationale.zh: 子宮收縮不良造成的低血容量徵象，需立即按摩並通知醫師。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which findings suggest postpartum depression rather than postpartum blues? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些表現較符合產後憂鬱症而非產後憂鬱情緒？（複選）

options.en: Loss of pleasure in usual activities

rationale.en: Suicidal thoughts, reduced infant responsiveness and anhedonia indicate depression.
rationale.zh: 自殺念頭、對嬰兒反應減少與失去興趣為憂鬱症表現。
